79165.subject:
We stopped trusting posted APY and built a better way to verify
 yields
79165.body:
View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/656bba33-6f29-4a51-9dc3-35d09f4e6464/Flare_top.jpg?t=1789487140)
Follow image link: (https://investors.defillama.com/flare)
Caption: 

Welcome to the DefiLlama Newsletter. This week we bring you a massive upgrade for the deepest onchain yields dataset on the planet.

# Verified Yields: What do you actually earn?

Ever deposit into a pool and think “why am I earning less than the stated APY?”

Most yields dashboards show you a general estimate of what a pool might yield.

They don’t show you:

* How much yield holders actually receive

* Whether you can exit the pool

* How fast

* What it costs

* How much you could withdraw right now

We verify all of this. Every day.

260+ pools from 47 protocols across 12 chains. $99B of tracked TVL is now Verified - including historical yields going back to May 2022.

Find Verified Yields (https://defillama.com/yields?attribute=verified)

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/429e7252-8c69-44ef-97ce-623050425459/image.png?t=1789480668)
Follow image link: (https://defillama.com/yields?apyWindow=avg_7d&attribute=verified)
Caption: 

## What am I actually earning in yield?

### == Verified APY: == What real holders received upon withdrawal

Every day we simulate a real holder withdrawing from each measured pool onchain and record what they actually received.

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/668c0ac1-911d-43a9-9280-ccae702d687c/image.png?t=1789479532)
Follow image link: (https://defillama.com/yields?attribute=verified)
Caption: _For the most stable APY figures, select 7d or 30d averages._

Each pool separates Verified Base rates from Reward rates - instantly we see this pool offers 2.7% more than the USDG median rate, how APY is calculated, how long it takes to exit the pool, and a 30d Stability rate.

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/5ff027c8-48de-4876-aa72-bf6f7ccff72d/image.png?t=1789485722)
Follow image link: (https://defillama.com/yields/pool/32f586b4-5358-5aa2-88ee-c842139e7023?range=30d&deposit=10000)
Caption: 

Below it we can accurately simulate how much growth a depositor would have experienced over different time frames.

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/c8119e14-58d2-47c7-9ad0-d62734a80187/image.png?t=1789480135)
Follow image link: (https://defillama.com/yields/pool/32f586b4-5358-5aa2-88ee-c842139e7023?range=30d&deposit=10000)
Caption: 

The sUSDS pool, for example, shows a $10k deposit grew to $10,679 over 571 days. Click anywhere on the growth chart to up
